Roustabouts, oil and gas (O*NET 47-5071.00) assemble or repair oil field equipment with hand and power tools, make up and break out tubulars, assist with lifting, lay pipelines, patrol for leaks, and clean vehicles and the well site. Pressurized work, lifting, repair, and return to work follow authorization.

O*NET 47-5071.00 provides oil and gas roustabout tasks and work activities; the BLS 2025—2035 occupational projections table for 47-5071 gives employment and median annual wages, and the O*NET national wage page gives BLS 2025 percentiles. subject.name: Roustabouts, Oil and Gas
subject.summary: Roustabouts, oil and gas, assemble and repair oil field equipment with hand and power tools, make up and break out tubulars, handle materials, patrol pipelines for leaks, and clean the well site; before work they verify personnel, equipment, loads, and isolation conditions, and on anomalies they stop work and hand over.
